ModMetaData.name: Fix Exosuit Dummy Meat
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho
ModMetaData.description: Exosuit Framework's internal Dummy pawn (ParentName="Human") inherits all Human race properties, causing RimWorld's ThingDefGenerator_Meat to auto-generate a "Meat_Dummy" item that shows up as an ugly "Human肉" in game. This patch adds useMeatFrom=Human to the Dummy's race, so the engine reuses vanilla human meat instead of generating a duplicate.
